candidate_scope: A falsifiable description of observable method records and transition contracts assembled from Step00-Step04 evidence; not a final definition of cognition, capability, inheritance, or the Ignition architecture.

evidence_basis.analysis_boundary: Artifacts and observable repository behavior only; no hidden reasoning traces, model-weight assumptions, Task180 verdict, Task182 material, Task186 report, Successor run, or Evaluator run.

layer_1_representation_phenotype.purpose: Carry observable work and method records; implementation carriers remain replaceable and are not themselves methods or evidence.
layer_1_representation_phenotype.minimum_boundary: A carrier's existence, name, schema validity, or successful execution cannot be promoted into a method, capability, truth, or inheritance claim without a separate test.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Name the task/question and typed objects, distinguish stable identity from label, and record the boundary of each object.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: The repository has asset identity contracts; a uniform task-to-method object framing behavior is not measured.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Retrieve candidate material by source/lineage, link each material claim to evidence refs and preserve evidence kind, version and claim ceiling.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Search/routing identifies and validates assets; no common graph connects a retrieved asset/relation to a method-use event and transfer result.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Keep source observation, evidence status, analogy and mechanism hypothesis in separately typed fields; do not infer proof from structural similarity or a tool report.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.state: EXISTING_GOVERNANCE_RULES; R0 MAKES THE METHOD SLOT EXPLICIT
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Rules and typed surfaces exist, but correct model behavior across unseen contexts is unmeasured.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Represent missing, conflicting and unresolved objects/relations explicitly; do not silently fill from conversational context or erase unknowns during migration.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Schema/fixture preservation is mechanical; it does not measure whether a successor notices uncertainty or abstains appropriately.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: State the applicability boundary, strongest alternative mechanism, counterexample/falsifier and what evidence would change the disposition.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.state: ACTIVE_FOUNDATION_AND_MECHANISM_REVIEW; R0 COMPOSES AS METHOD SLOT
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: The availability of gates/tests does not prove alternatives are complete or consistently used.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Choose among explicit alternatives using stakes/affordable loss, expected observation, rollback/exit and a discriminating next test; record why and what is not claimed.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Task179 records a select-action slot; earlier bounded decisions and runtime budgets do not establish causal-radius-proportional cognition or reliable general selection.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Record observed failure/anomaly, recurrence hypothesis, source run, affected method/object, failure boundary and unresolved cause without conflating memory with evidence.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Storage, recurrence and repository remediation are present in different owners; no common method-use/transfer chain is established.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: On an evidenced inadequacy, preserve predecessor, propose a reframing/new method, compare predicted behavior, record gains/losses and unknowns, then retain rollback/migration lineage.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: The typed record is a new composition; no independent result shows that recorded revisions improve behavior or transfer.

layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.minimum_observable_contract: Keep a blind-first evaluator and adjudicator boundary separate from Builder; report reconstruction, continuation, uncertainty and non-equivalence controls; keep unmeasured as unmeasured.
layer_2_inheritable_method_candidate.gap_or_limit: Task179 metrics remain NOT_YET_MEASURED. This candidate defines no execution authorization and Task185 runs neither successor nor evaluator.

layer_3_metacognitive_evolution_candidat.observable_contract: Tie an anomaly/failure or unresolved question to the limitation of the previous representation; preserve the observation separately from the interpretation.
Record old/new representation and method, expected discriminating observations, retained/lost structure, complexity and known counterexamples.
Record ADOPT/REJECT/COEXIST/UNRESOLVED, source refs, backward-readable migration, rollback and retirement conditions without silent overwrite.

candidate_invariants: No hidden chain-of-thought storage or inference from private reasoning traces.
No schema, tag, registry, retrieval result, validator PASS, CI status, or workflow success becomes evidence of cognition by itself.
Foundation/Current canonical authority, claim ceilings and Owner/evaluator roles remain separate.
Unknowns, source lineage, strongest alternatives and failed/retired methods remain addressable.
An adoption decision requires evidence beyond package shape and must remain reversible or explicitly bounded.
explicit_gaps_for_later_steps: No unified asset/relation-to-method-use-to-transfer record is demonstrated.
No general method-selection or cognitive-budget rule tied to causal reach/reversibility is demonstrated.
No measured capability rediscovery across model/provider replacement is demonstrated.
No measured independent transfer or cognitive improvement is claimed.
downgrade_or_falsification_conditions: If the proposed fields cannot be reconstructed from exact source refs, shrink or split the candidate.
If field-level ablation shows no distinct consumer or no reconstruction loss, remove or merge the corresponding candidate slot only through an authorized migration.

If independent tests fail to distinguish method transfer from schema imitation, ordinary context reconstruction or style matching, keep the candidate as an artifact taxonomy rather than a cognitive-method claim.
claim_ceiling: A noncanonical research candidate for an observable cognitive-method record and evolution cycle; not a final definition, canonical claim, proven capability, cognitive inheritance result, model improvement, or authorization to execute R1/MetaRSI/Model-RSI.
